# Dependencies of the local rank-one Tits index proof

The list at the end of this page names the Library declarations on which the proof depends. The Weil restriction and its point operations come from the Library's own modules `Langlands.RingTheory.WeilRestriction.PresentedAlgebra` (the Weil restriction, its universal point, representing bijection and functoriality), `Langlands.RingTheory.WeilRestriction.Smooth` (its smoothness), `Langlands.RingTheory.WeilRestriction.PointMultiplication` (its bialgebra structure and the convolution product of its points) and `Langlands.RingTheory.WeilRestriction.Units` (the points of the Weil restriction of the multiplicative group as units); further entries come from `Langlands.RingTheory.HopfAlgebra.PointGroup`, `Langlands.RingTheory.Coalgebra.TensorConvolution`, `Langlands.RingTheory.HopfAlgebra.CocommutativePoints`, `Langlands.RingTheory.Extension.Presentation.MapsOut`, `Langlands.RingTheory.TensorProduct.QuotientKernel` and `Langlands.Algebra.Polynomial.Laurent.Smooth`. The list contains only public declarations of the modules named here, not their private declarations or generated auxiliary lemmas such as `_proof_` lemmas.

The audit ran on Library commit `7ae0d83b7cb2ad9aaca52ada487b3a5d3314323a` in its pinned Lean
environment. It checked that the type of `Langlands.GroupScheme.localRankOneTitsIndex`
is literally `Langlands.GroupScheme.LocalRankOneTitsIndexStatement.{u}`, with
the single universe parameter `u`.

The scan starts from the constants in the proof term. It follows declaration
types and values recursively, including opaque theorem values. It checks the
entire closure for the target statement, the target theorem and names
containing `LocalRankOneClassification` or `KneserTits`, regardless of case,
in declaration names or defining modules. It visited 191,459 constants
and found zero hits.

## Reproduce the audit

Save this scanner as `LocalRankOneTitsIndexDependencyAudit.lean` at the corresponding module path in a
checkout of the Library and compile the module `Langlands.GroupScheme.SimplyConnected.LocalRankOneTitsIndexDependencyAudit`. The
information messages give the sorted list in blocks of at most 512 entries.

```lean
import Langlands.GroupScheme.SimplyConnected.LocalRankOneTitsIndexProof

open Lean Elab Command

namespace LocalRankOneTitsIndexAudit

private def moduleName (env : Environment) (name : Name) : Name :=
  (env.getModuleIdxFor? name).map
    (fun index => env.header.moduleNames[index.toNat]!) |>.getD .anonymous

private def isExcluded (name origin : Name) : Bool :=
  let downstream (s : String) :=
    let lower := s.toLower
    (lower.splitOn "localrankoneclassification").length > 1 ||
      (lower.splitOn "knesertits").length > 1
  name == `Langlands.GroupScheme.LocalRankOneTitsIndexStatement ||
    name == `Langlands.GroupScheme.localRankOneTitsIndex ||
    downstream name.toString || downstream origin.toString

private def collect (env : Environment) (start : Array Name) : Array Name × Array Name := Id.run do
  let mut queue := #[]
  let mut visited : Std.HashSet Name := {}
  let mut missing := #[]
  for name in start do
    if !visited.contains name then
      queue := queue.push name
      visited := visited.insert name
  let mut cursor := 0
  while cursor < queue.size do
    let name := queue[cursor]!
    cursor := cursor + 1
    let some info := env.find? name
      | missing := missing.push name
        continue
    let used := info.type.getUsedConstants ++
      (info.value? (allowOpaque := true)).elim #[] Expr.getUsedConstants
    for dependency in used do
      if !visited.contains dependency then
        queue := queue.push dependency
        visited := visited.insert dependency
  return (queue, missing)

elab "#auditLocalRankOneTitsIndex" : command => do
  let env ← getEnv
  let proof := `Langlands.GroupScheme.localRankOneTitsIndex
  let statement := `Langlands.GroupScheme.LocalRankOneTitsIndexStatement
  let some info := env.find? proof | throwError "Missing theorem {proof}"
  unless info.levelParams == [`u] && info.type == mkConst statement [.param `u] do
    throwError "The theorem type differs from {statement} at universe u"
  let some value := info.value? (allowOpaque := true) | throwError "Missing proof term for {proof}"
  let (dependencies, missing) := collect env value.getUsedConstants
  unless missing.isEmpty do
    throwError "Unknown constants in the proof closure {missing.toList}"
  let library := dependencies.filterMap fun n =>
    let origin := moduleName env n
    if (`Langlands).isPrefixOf origin then some (n.toString, origin.toString) else none
  let excluded := dependencies.filter fun n => isExcluded n (moduleName env n)
  unless excluded.isEmpty do
    throwError "Downstream or circular dependencies {excluded.toList}"
  logInfo m!"Dependency audit visited {dependencies.size} constants, including {library.size} from Library modules. Excluded hits 0."
  let sorted := library.qsort fun a b => a.1 < b.1
  for first in [0:sorted.size:512] do
    let entries := (sorted.extract first (first + 512)).toList.map Prod.fst
    logInfo m!"BEGIN LIBRARY CONSTANTS {first}\n{String.intercalate "\n" entries}\nEND LIBRARY CONSTANTS"

#auditLocalRankOneTitsIndex
```
